question: the three defines gaps OpenHOI3 had left: demobilising's manpower, strategic warfare's allies term, and whether a lend-lease convoy's efficiency is saved

addresses.name: CToggleMobilizationCommand::Execute
addresses.comment: Slot 6 of CToggleMobilizationCommand (see CCommand::Execute). 0x551490 to the bare `ret` at 0x55221C; slot 7 begins at 0x552220. The command carries the country at +0x3C/+0x40 and the mobilise flag at +0x44. It calls 0x507A20(flag, country) - CCountry_SetMobilised - then CCountry::RebuildNeighbours and 0x4E39C0 on the country, then **SpreadThreat(country, &MOBILIZE_THREAT_IMPACT (country defines +0x50), &scale, the country's acting capital)** at 0x551565 with scale = (flag ? 2 : 0) - 1 thousand, i.e. +1000 to mobilise and **-1000 to demobilise**, so demobilising takes the threat back off (floored at 0 per pair). Then a COUNTRY message for the player, its text by the flag (0x5518DF): a mobilise order ends there (0x5521FE), and **an order to stand down, mobilised or not, gives manpower back** in CToggleMobilizationCommand_DemobiliseManpower (0x5520A1-0x5521F8). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-definesuse.md, section 7.
addresses.revises: comment: the demobilising loop read whole and given its own entry; only on standing down; 0x507A20 named as the record already names it
addresses.evidence: cmp byte [ecx+0x44], bl; je 0x551C9A at 0x5518DF; the flag-set path's two message arms end jmp 0x5521FE (0x551B10, 0x551C95); the flag-clear path falls through 0x551ED6 jmp 0x552083 into the loop.

addresses.name: CToggleMobilizationCommand_DemobiliseManpower
addresses.comment: **What standing down gives back**, to 0x5521F8. factor = DEMOBILIZATION_FACTOR (country defines +0x64, 0x5520AC). For each unit of the command's country's Units (+0xBAC, every level) and each sub unit of its +0x38: excess = strength (+0x5C) - *GetMaxStrength(&out, 0, 0) (slot 12, 0x552104); nothing more where excess <= 0 (0x55210C). Else, def = the sub unit's own definition (+0x58): men = excess * 1000 / def->max_strength (+0xEC), then * def->build_cost_manpower (+0xFC) / 1000, then * factor / 1000 (__allmul / __alldiv, to 0x55216E); strength_ceiling (+0x30) = 0 (0x55217E); m = the lesser of two more GetMaxStrength(&out, 0, 0) answers, not below nought; strength = m, strength_ceiling raised to m (0x5521AF-0x5521B7); the country's manpower (+0xBCC) += men, floored at nought (0x5521D6). GetMaxStrength reads neither field set, so all three answers are one: max_strength, cut by RESERVES_PENALTY_SIZE for a reserve whose owner (CSubUnit::GetOwner, the lender for a lent unit) is neither mobilised (+0x94, already cleared by CCountry_SetMobilised) nor at war (+0xACC). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-definesuse.md, section 7.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x552080-0x55221C; the three slot-12 calls at 0x552104, 0x552181 and 0x552191 each push (out, 0, 0); CSubUnit::GetMaxStrength (0x1AB680) read for what it reads.

addresses.name: CLandCombatant_AlliesImpactDaily
addresses.comment: **Strategic warfare's allies term**, at the end of CLandCombatant::Attack after the side has fired, to 0x56B7B6. Only where (tick (game state +0xBDC) - 43800000) % 24 == 0, the first hour of a day. p = the battle province (combat +0x3C -> +0x18), C its controller (+0x334/+0x338); for an attacking side (+0x38) with units (+0x40), where IsFriend(the province owner's country (+0x330), the first unit's owner (+0x124), 1) (0x56B4BC), p = that unit's current province (+0x130) and C its controller. Nothing where p's area (+0x2B4) is not the area of GetActingCapitalLocation(C) (0x56B507), where IsFriend(p's owner's country, C, 1) fails (0x56B532), where C's strong_allies_at_war count (+0xFC0) is not above nought or the side has no units (0x56B551-0x56B560). Then for each unit of the side: n = (int)floorf(((float)regiments_count (+0x40) + 0.0005f) * 1000); a unit whose owner id (+0x128) is C's adds n x STRAT_NO_ALLIES_HELP_PENALTY (military +0x140) / 1000, one whose owner id is on C's strong_allies_at_war (+0xFB8; id at +4, next at +0xC) n x STRAT_ALLIES_HELP (+0x144) / 1000, through CStrategicWarfare::AddAlliesImpact on C's StrategicWarfare (+0x1184, 0x56B7A6). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-definesuse.md, section 9.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x56B3C5-0x56B7C7 (the two inlined GetDefines branches aside); the constants at VA 0x160A460 and 0x160A300 read as doubles 0.0005 and 1000. Measured through OpenHOI3, a look: Ireland1939_09_01_00 to _09_06_18, Poland alone has entries in the save and in the rebuild.

addresses.name: g_SaveKey_lendlease_effectiveness
addresses.comment: The save's key object for `lendlease_effectiveness` (string VA 0x15E4258), id 0x83C, made by a static initialiser at VA 0xD0B943-0xD0B95A. The id is used in CCountry::SaveContents (VA 0x4D2254), so it is a country's figure - which one was not read - and **not a convoy's**: neither CConvoy::SaveContents nor CConvoy::LoadKey uses it, and a convoy's lend_lease_efficiency (+0xAC) is not saved. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-definesuse.md, section 10.
addresses.evidence: mov edx,0x15E4258 at VA 0xD0B943 ... mov ecx,0x83C; mov esi,0x1B11540 at VA 0xD0B955-0xD0B95A; the immediate 0x83C searched over .text: CCountry::SaveContents among its 34 sites, no CConvoy routine.

addresses.comment: The save's key object for `lendlease_targets` (string VA 0x15E4610), id 0x806, made by the same run of static initialisers (VA 0xD0AFFB-0xD0B012). Used by CConvoy::LoadKey (VA 0x4C544F) and CConvoy::SaveContents (VA 0x4C58FC), and by CCountry::SaveContents (VA 0x4D2232). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-definesuse.md, section 10.
